title: Containers and Docker
summary: Run, network, store, and ship the Docker version of Dispatch, including a hardened image.
reason: A real Docker mission rather than a quiz: if you pass it on your own, you can skip ahead to Kubernetes.

title: Kubernetes applications
summary: Run Dispatch on Kubernetes with configuration, storage, routing, safe rollouts, and health probes.
reason: Knowing Docker well does not mean you know Kubernetes yet; this mission checks the CKAD-style skills.

title: Platform engineering and security
summary: Add delivery, monitoring, capacity limits, and least-privilege security around Dispatch.
reason: Dispatch must keep working while the security and operating rules hold.

title: Cluster administration
summary: Keep a real multi-node kubeadm cluster running through an outage, then hand it over.
reason: An advanced mission on four VMs. Try it when you want to test the CKA-style administration skills.
